title: Editing, mixing: Greenfield Morning I Pushed An Empty Baby Carriage All Over The City, Paper Shoes by Yoko Ono | 1970
content:
Studio Three, EMI Studios, Abbey Road
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono
Engineers: Phil McDonald, Andy Stephens

An editing and mixing session for Yoko Ono’s debut solo album, Yoko Ono/Plastic Ono Band, took place on 5 November 1970.

An edit piece containing bird sounds had been added the previous day. It was then mixed in stereo, and crossfaded with a tanpura piece recorded by John Lennon and George Harrison on 25 October.
